name: AppFollow
description:
User ratings, reviews & ASO for App Store, Google Play, Trustpilot, Steam, Mac App Store, Microsoft Store, Samsung Galaxy Store, Huawei AppGallery, and more. Connect your AppFollow account via MCP for ratings, reviews, replies, AI summaries, rankings, keywords, apps & workspaces.

Plug AppFollow directly into Claude via the remote MCP server at mcp.appfollow.io/mcp. Sign in securely with your Google account and give Claude access only to the apps and workspaces you choose.

The AppFollow MCP server provides 30 specialized tools for app reputation management, customer feedback analysis, review operations, and App Store Optimization (ASO). Claude can retrieve live data from your AppFollow account to analyze trends, answer questions, and help you make better product and marketing decisions.

With AppFollow MCP, Claude can:

* Analyze ratings and reviews across all connected stores and review platforms.
* Generate AI summaries and identify sentiment, bugs, feature requests, and praise.
* Search and filter reviews by app, country, version, language, rating, and date.
* Draft, rewrite, translate, and improve review replies in your preferred tone and language.
* Access rating metrics, historical trends, keyword rankings, featured placements, and ASO insights.
* Retrieve information about your apps, workspaces, tags, reports, and AppFollow configuration.
* Compare apps, versions, countries, and competitors to uncover trends and opportunities.
* Combine AppFollow data with Claude to generate reports, answer complex questions, and produce actionable recommendations.

Authentication is handled through Google Sign-In, and every request is securely scoped to your own AppFollow account—no API keys required.

We’d love your feedback. Send it directly through the MCP server or email support@appfollow.io to help us improve AppFollow MCP, expand our tools, and add new capabilities.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AppFollow to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AppFollow to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.appfollow.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AppFollow MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AppFollow lists 32 MCP tools, including add_app, add_app_preview, add_collection, add_collection_preview, add_keywords, add_keywords_preview, aso_featured_apps, aso_search_ads_recommendations, aso_search_results, aso_search_suggestions, get_aso_report_app_store, and get_aso_report_gdc_google_play.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AppFollow?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AppFollow in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
AppFollow requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AppFollow is developed by AppFollow. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
